frases: This deck railing won't hold you!
Hit like and follow. Flo is leaning on it right now!
Relax! The post is screwed right into the deck. It's solid!
Screwed into one board. The outside rim. That's it.
Lean on the top, and it works like a crowbar. It pries that board right off.
Come on. How much can one lean do?
Code says a railing must hold two hundred pounds, pushed on the top.
In Virginia Tech tests, some screwed posts let go at about a quarter of that.
Okay. So how do I fix it?
Tie the post into the deck joists. Blocking, through bolts, and a metal hold down.
Now the push goes into the whole deck, not one board.
Fine. I'll lean on it. Carefully.
A railing screwed to the rim. Safe, or a fall waiting to happen? Team Norm or Team Flo?
Follow for more backyard builds that won't fail!
